alltools.actions.action-wizard.note: printcraft engine/actions.rs and actions_ui.rs (commands/actions.mjs): the action runs on the open document, step by step, as one undo step. Running an action over many files into a folder is not offered.

alltools.actions.prepare-for-distributio.note: printcraft engine/actions.rs and actions_ui.rs (commands/actions.mjs): the action runs on the open document, step by step, as one undo step. Opens the Action Wizard on Prepare for Distribution.

alltools.actions.optimize-scanned-docume.note: printcraft engine/actions.rs and actions_ui.rs (commands/actions.mjs): the action runs on the open document, step by step, as one undo step. Opens the Action Wizard on Optimize Scanned Documents.

alltools.actions.archive-documents.note: The Archive Documents action: Save as PDF/A as far as can be done, and what remains (not checked against upstream: it lists the action as planned). Opens the Action Wizard on it.

dialog.action-wizard.note: printcraft actions_ui.rs: the list of actions, their steps, New Action, Edit, Delete. The body is src/apps/folio/dialogs/action-wizard.tsx; the action runs on the open document (upstream runs it over files into a folder). "Run a JavaScript" is not a step: scripts are never run.
